register.aee_hook_pass: pass at after_specify, after_plan, after_tasks (0 failure modes, 0 below the 0.70 threshold; aee/ artifacts)

basis.decisions: owner commission 2026-10-13 ('Design experiments for all of the 35 that remain in question or inconclusive') produced the experiment-design portfolio (draft PR #195), whose design D-30 this spec carries without deviation; owner order 2026-10-13 06:39 EDT ('Freeze D-30, D-03, and D-20 for execution') adopted the design as written and is the adjudicating act for this freeze; execution runs after the OSF registration of this frozen contract verifies public
basis.register_recovery: AEE pass rounds 1-3 iterate (17, then 4, then 1 failure modes); recovered per the Spec 030/031 pattern and passed at all three phases; record aee/recovery-specify.md

design.question_owner: the PRED register (docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md): PRED-2026-006, registered 2026-04-22; Spec 032 owns the scoring design, its freeze, and its registration

registered_criterion.quantity: share of the frozen trained INITIAL signs whose Harappa start rate is at least 0.40, computed on the withheld Harappa-site Yajnadevam sequences only

design.step0: fails closed: (1) the trained INITIAL set is reconstructed from the recorded global_class_stability lineage and frozen; (2) the withholding is verified as CISI Mohenjo-daro only; (3) sign identity is carried by the existing crosswalks under data/crosswalks, fixed before counting. A failed check closes the study as CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN
design.unmappable_rule: trained signs with no crosswalk counterpart are counted and reported as UNMAPPABLE; coverage above 20 percent of the trained set is stated in the verdict's first sentence
design.verdict_mapping: CONFIRMED at a share of at least 70 percent; NOT CONFIRMED below it; no inconclusive band exists in the registered criterion and none is invented; step-0 closures are reported as themselves, never as verdicts
design.descriptive_addition: the per-sign table (every trained sign, its Harappa count, its start rate) is published with the outcome; descriptive only, carries no criterion
design.register_handling: the outcome is appended to the PRED register as a dated entry at execution; the register's existing text is never edited
design.execution_gate: OSF registration of this frozen contract before any execution (program precedent pnqrx / 7m35w / bge3k / jtwvc); execution follows the verified approval under the owner's 2026-10-13 order

inputs.crosswalks: data/crosswalks/ (Yajnadevam-to-Parpola crosswalk files and their recorded statistics)
